The [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]] [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]] was equipped with twin [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] '''ANx-y long-range sensor arrays''' that were placed ahead of the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and fed data in the primary [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array and [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] located between the two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] in the nose of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
